answer: Each identity lists a self-assessed price in the Orchard registry, minimum 50 POA, and pays 5% of it as tax each epoch; anyone may buy it at that price, so pricing low invites a forced sale. New identities start at the nadir tier, capped at 2 POA for 3 epochs, then reach the summit tier with full rewards. Tax rises 1 point per extra identity from one funding cluster, capped at 20%, so 100 fakes pay about 950 POA per epoch against 250 for 100 honest users. Two missed payments freeze the identity and forfeit its 20 POA bond locked 90 days. If rewards pass 10 POA, the minimum rises to match.
